title: Make the writing bigger on iPhone
aliases: how do i make the writing bigger
make the letters larger on my phone
i cannot read the small writing
make my iphone easier to read

steps.instruction: Drag the slider to the right until the sample writing is easy to read.

source_note: Settings on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Uses Display & Brightness > Text Size. For even larger writing, the alternative is Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Larger Text. Some apps do not follow the system text size. Not checked on a phone. Source: https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iphd6804774e/26/ios/26
